best: The four-switch power stage and the 3V3 buck read as clean textbook left-to-right power paths with in-line shunts, Kelvin filters and well-annotated block titles and notes.
worst: The BQ40Z50 gauge and BQ25756 charger are fed by long parallel wire fans and bare net-name stubs, so pin-to-part tracing takes effort
Uneven density: large empty areas (3V3 lower half, Cells centre, MCU right) beside cramped USB/PD clusters
Small text collisions such as the stacked GND pin numbers under U401/U405 and many bare stub net names (CC1, CELL_1N) instead of wires or flags
